lines: “沈大郎何在？”
“回大人，大郎病卧在床…”
“少废话！欠白老爷的租子何时还上？”
“大人息怒，求您宽限两日…”
“娘，我饿…”
耳畔隐隐传来喝骂与低泣。
沈修寒缓缓睁开眼。
眼前是熟悉的破草屋、旧炕桌，以及一股挥之不去的药汤味。
他轻吐一口气，干裂的嘴唇微微扯动：
“第三天了…”
这里是齐国沧州南乡府治下，长云县。
县城依湖而建，世代以渔为生。
原身沈大郎，是内城大户白家的佃户之子。
父亲唤作沈三槐，靠着租用白家的一条小舢板，日日泛舟湖上，打渔糊口。
家中穷困潦倒，栖身于外城的“小径湾”贫民窟。
为让妻儿过上安生日子，沈三槐省吃俭用，只盼多攒些银钱，有朝一日能搬进内城，租一间能遮风避雨的屋子。
岂料半月前，一次寻常出湖，竟遭了水怪。
人，再未能归来。
渔网、舢板，亦被卷走。
原身在悲伤与饥寒交迫中一病不起。
再睁眼时。
已经换成从饭店下班回家撞大运的沈修寒…
“咳咳…”
沈修寒干咳两声，艰难靠坐起来，听着屋外响起可怜巴巴的女声：
“娘，我饿…”
“沫沫乖，咱不饿啊。”
“娘，沫沫想喝粥…”
“沫沫听话，粥是为你大兄发汗用的，等他病愈了，就能给沫沫抓鱼吃了…”
记忆翻涌。
妇人是母亲郑氏，小女孩则是他的亲妹妹，沈沫沫。
自他病倒，家中为数不多的余财，全被郑氏换了药汤和粟米给他治病。
本就风雨飘摇的家，已彻底揭不开锅。
嘎吱，嘎吱…
踩雪声渐近。
草帘掀开。
郑氏端碗走进来，低头吹着碗里热腾腾的药汤：
“大郎，该喝药了…”
可当她抬起头，看到沈修寒醒来靠坐在床头时，布满血丝和疲惫的眼眸，陡然迸发出难以掩饰的欢喜！
“呀！大郎醒啦！”
content_en:
"Where is Shen Dalang?"
"Back to my lord, Dalang is ill in bed..."
"Stop talking nonsense! When will the rent owed to Mr. Bai be repaid?"
"My lord, please calm down and please grant me two days of grace..."
"Mom, I'm hungry..."
There were faint curses and sobs in my ears.
Shen Xiuhan slowly opened his eyes.
In front of me are the familiar dilapidated thatched huts, old kang tables, and the lingering smell of medicinal soup.
He exhaled softly, and his chapped lips twitched slightly:
"It's the third day..."
This is Changyun County under the rule of Nanxiang Prefecture in Cangzhou, Qi State.
The county seat is built on the lake, and people have made a living by fishing for generations.
His original name is Shen Dalang, the son of a tenant of the Bai family, a wealthy family in the inner city.
His father was called Shen Sanhuai, and he made a living by renting a small sampan from the Bai family, boating on the lake and fishing every day.
The family is impoverished and lives in the "Xiao Xiaowan" slum in the outer city.
In order to let his wife and children live a peaceful life, Shen Sanhuai lived frugally, hoping to save more money so that one day he could move into the inner city and rent a house that could be sheltered from the wind and rain.
Unexpectedly, half a month ago, when I went out of the lake, I encountered a water monster.
People never come back.
Fishing nets and sampans were also swept away.
The original body became ill due to grief, hunger and cold.
When you open your eyes again.
Shen Xiuhan has been replaced by Shen Xiuhan who comes home from get off work at the hotel to get lucky...
"Ahem..."
Shen Xiuhan coughed twice and sat up with difficulty, listening to a pitiful female voice outside the room:
"Mom, I'm hungry..."
"Momo, be good, we're not hungry."
"Mom, Momo wants to drink porridge..."
"Momo, be obedient. The porridge is for your eldest brother to sweat. When he recovers, you can catch fish for Momo to eat..."
Memories surged.
The woman is his mother, Mrs. Zheng, and the little girl is his biological sister, Shen Momo.
Since he fell ill, Zheng's family's little remaining wealth was used in exchange for medicinal soup and corn to treat his illness.
The family, which was already in turmoil, could no longer be opened.
Crunch, crunch…
The sound of treading on the snow is approaching.
The straw curtain is opened.
Mrs. Zheng walked in with a bowl, lowered her head and blew on the hot medicinal soup in the bowl:
"Dalang, it's time to drink medicine..."
But when she raised her head and saw Shen Xiuhan waking up and sitting on the bedside, his bloodshot and tired eyes suddenly burst into unconcealable joy!
"Ah! Dalang is awake!"
